feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: New Mexico wanted free childcare for all. This is what's worked — and what hasn't
entry.summary: A year ago in November, New Mexico became the first state to offer free childcare to every eligible family, regardless of income.

entry.title: Midterm voters ended the long-running GOP dominance in state legislatures
entry.summary: In several states, Democrats took control of legislatures that had been divided and they weakened GOP dominance in others. Issues on the agenda: More access to health care, new limits on school vouchers.

entry.title: A new generation of disability rights activists carry on Judy Heumann's legacy
entry.summary: The film Being Heumann tells the lesser-known story of the mother of the disability rights movement. A new generation of activists share how they "carry the torch" today.

entry.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from moving ahead on Washington public golf course redevelopment
entry.summary: A federal judge on Saturday ordered a two-week delay to any work at a historic Washington public golf course not far from the White House.

entry.title: FAA ground stop disrupts college football
entry.summary: Some college football games were delayed a few hours on Saturday or postponed to Sunday. And in Oklahoma at least, there will be perks for fans to make up for the inconvenience, including cheap beers.

entry.title: Florida city cancels St. Patrick's Day parade, citing new anti-DEI law
entry.summary: A new Florida law that prohibits taxpayer dollars from going toward diversity initiatives has prompted Delray Beach to cancel its St. Patrick's Day parade after a nearly 60-year run.

entry.title: US has lost measles elimination status, global health authorities say
entry.summary: The U.S. has lost its status as a country where measles is eliminated, according to researchers with direct knowledge of the deliberations at the Pan American Health Organization.

entry.title: SpaceX successfully catches Starship and makes history
entry.summary: The company's spacecraft returned to its Texas launchpad in dramatic fashion — by carefully lowering itself until two metal arms attached to the launch tower could secure it.

entry.title: 'We can't let them down' -- After midterm wins, Democrats turn to charting path ahead
entry.summary: Democrats from across the country descended on Denver for a two-day conference to chart the course of their party after sweeping victories in the midterm elections.

entry.title: Tiny Desk Radio: Nduduzo Makhathini, Burna Boy, Ayra Starr
entry.summary: Host Bobby Carter presents three African artists who are pushing the boundaries of jazz and pop. Look for Tiny Desk Radio on your local NPR station.
